newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Mexico IPC index target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Mexico IPC index target raised.

text.p: Caspian Research said it had raised its year-end target for the Mexican bourse's blue chip IPC index to 5,500 points from 4,700 in a research report on Tuesday.

-- Analysts Francois Gour, Damian Fraser and Santiago Millan wrote the target had been raised due to lower perceived political risk following "clean, transparent and peaceful" mid-term elections held in Mexico on Sunday, which would allow interest rates to fall in real terms.
-- The analysts said they expected strong second and third quarter corporate earnings.

-- "Higher than expected foreign inflows into Latin America due to receding fears of of U.S. interest (rate) increases and strong mutual fund purchases in the United States" would also boost Mexican shares, they wrote.
-- Caspian said the new target implied a return of 9.4 percent in U.S. dollars based on a predicted year-end exchange rate of 8.40 pesos per dollar.
-- The IPC index was up 2.40 percent at 4,854.87 points.
